Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800

Simon —

Thanks for the heads up and context. Congrats on the successful ingest test — totally expected that spike. We can support you here; a couple of quick options from our side so we can get you uninterrupted service by EOD:

1) 2-week runway extension (no additional charge) — requires a short PO addendum confirming the new end date (Dec 15) and that usage beyond the cap will be reconciled against the original rate card.

2) One-time pro-rated credit equal to the estimated overage (we calculate based on yesterday's 24h run rate).

3) Temporary soft increase of the concurrency cap (48 hours) while you finish taxonomy validation — useful if you expect the spike to recede quickly.

Operational asks from our side: if you choose option 1 or 3, we need a PO addendum or written confirmation from procurement by Dec 3 so we can make the routing change. Option 2 can be handled immediately from finance and won't require a PO.

If you want the no-cost runway extension, I can draft the addendum and loop legal. Which do you prefer? Call slots: 11–12 PT today or 9–10 PT tomorrow.

—Alex
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
